content: {"praised": ["Informative and interesting documentary about the Eagles.", "Fascinating look at the band’s songwriting and musicianship.", "Great live concert footage with excellent sound and video.", "Comprehensive story covering the band from start to finish.", "Engaging interviews with both old and current members."], "criticized": ["Don Felder given too little screen time.", "Felder’s vocals not showcased for viewers to judge.", "Lack of mention of Randy Meisner’s background.", "Unequal focus on Henley and Frey over other members.", "Insufficient coverage of other band members’ contributions."]}
